title: Anime NYC Screens World Premiere of Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized! Anime
content: Crunchyroll announced on Monday that it will screen the world premiere for the first two episodes of the television anime of Haka Tokura 's Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized! light novel series at this year's Anime NYC event on August 22.
author: ANN

title: Kagurabachi Confirms Return Date to End Shonen Jump Hiatus
content: Kagurabachi has been on a hiatus from the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine this Summer, but it has finally confirmed a date for when it’s coming back for new chapters.
author: ComicBook

title: Sakamoto Days Manga Heads to Climax
content: The manga started its "final battle" in August 2025. Suzuki published a one-shot titled "Sakamoto" in Shueisha 's Jump Giga in December 2019, and then launched the main manga in Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in November 2020. Viz Media and MANGA Plus are publishing the manga in English digitally.
author: ANN

title: New King of the Hill Finale Gives Hank the Promotion He’s Been Waiting For, Showrunner Teases What’s Next (Exclusive)
content: King of the Hill has made a major change for Hank’s future with its Season 15 finale, and the showrunner behind it all teased ComicBook about what this promotion means for Hank in future seasons.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Fans Just Unleashed the Shinjuku Showdown Fight the Anime’s Been Waiting For
content: Warning! Massive spoilers for Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s anime future to follow! Jujutsu Kaisen is currently gearing up for the beginning of the end as the anime is preparing to return with the second half of the Culling Game arc in the future.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece Gets Official LEGO Makeover With New Netflix Special – Watch First Look Trailer
content: One Piece is gearing up for a full LEGO makeover coming to Netflix with a new special later this Fall, and now the first look trailer reveals what fans can expect to see from it in action.
author: ComicBook

title: TIFF Screens N. American Premiere of Live-Action Look Back Film
content: TIFF will take place on September 10-20. The festival will reveal its release schedule on August 11. The film opens on September 11 in Japan. GKIDS will release the film in theaters in 2026 in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., and Ireland.
author: ANN

title: Bleach’s Final Season Readies for This Week’s Premiere With Wildest Orihime Look Yet
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is gearing up for the debut of its final season of episodes later this week, and the anime is counting down to its premiere with its wildest look at Orihime Inoue yet.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Removes Even More Classic Anime You Can’t Find Anywhere Else & Fans Aren’t Happy
content: Crunchyroll has removed even more classic anime offerings from its streaming library in the United States this month, and fans aren’t happy because these shows are not available to stream anywhere else.
author: ComicBook

title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc Reveals Opening Song by Boy Band JO1
content: The staff for Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc ( Tokyo Revengers: Santen Sensō-hen ), the latest arc of the Tokyo Revengers anime, revealed on Monday the new arc's opening theme song "IGNITE" by boy band JO1 .
author: ANN
